title: gomphandra capitulata
intro: Gomphandra capitulata, commonly known as the Kapok tree or Kapok bush, is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gomphandra capitulata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for medicinal use, as the available scientific data is limited.
